chapter.verse: Nipi ni khatvei Zeisu in buhlei ah a vak leh, a nungzuite in buhvui zut uh a, khut tawh nuai-in a ne uh hi.
Farisaite kimkhat in, “Nipi ni-in ahih tuak loh na bang dingin na hih uh hiam?” a ci uh hi.
Zeisu in, “David in ama lawmte tawh a gilkial lai takin,
Pasian biakna inn sungah lut a, siampite longal midangte nek ding kilawm lo khomun siangtho la-in ne a, a lawmte zong a piak thu sim ngeilo na hi uh hiam?
Mihing Tapa in Nipi ni ukpa ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Adang Nipi ni-in Zeisu in kikhopna inn sungah lut a, thu a hilh hi. Tua lai-ah a khut langkhat a si mi khat a om hi.
Nipi ni-in cinatna damsak ding hiam damsak lo ding hiam, ci-in laitheite leh Farisaite in Zeisu a mawhsak nop manun a en uh hi.
Ahih hangin Zeisu in amau’ sinsung ngaihsutna uh a theih ciangin, “Tho in la, a lai zangah ding in,” ci-in khut sipa kiangah a ci hi. Amah thoin a ding hi.
Zeisu in, “Note kong dong ding hi; ‘Nipi ni-in phatna bawl tuak hiam? Siatna bawl tuak hiam? Nuntakna khatpeuh a gup tuak hiam? Nuntakna siatsak tuak ahi hiam?’” ci-in amaute kiangah a dong hi.
Amaute khempeuh en kawikawi a, “Na khut zan in,” ci-in tuapa kiangah ci-a, a khut a zan leh, a dam hi.
Ahih hangin amaute heh mahmah uh a, Zeisu tungah, “Bangci i hih ding hiam?” ci-in khat leh khat a kikum uh hi.
Tua lai takin Zeisu in thu ngen dingin mual tungah kahto a, Pasian kiangah thu ngenin zan khat tawntung a om hi.
Khua a vak ciangin a nungzuite sam a, Sawm-le-nihte teelin, ‘Sawltakte’ ci-in a phuak hi.
Tuate in: Simon, a min thak a phuah Piter leh a naupa Andru, Jakob leh Johan, Filip leh Bartholomai,
Mattiu leh Thomas, Alefas’ tapa Jakob leh Zealot kici Simon,
Jakob’ tapa Judas leh Topa lehheekpa Judas Iskariot ahi uh hi.

Zeisu in amaute tawh mual tung pan kumsuk khawm a, mun zangah a ding hi. Thu ngaih nading ahi zongin, cidamna ngah nading ahi zongin, Judah gam pan akipan, Jerusalem khuapi pan, Tai-ar leh Sidon khua tuipi gei pan, mi tampite leh ama nungzuite tampite zong hong pai uh hi.
A kihhuai dawi’ bawlsiatna a thuak mite in zong cidamna a ngah uh hi.
Mihonpite khempeuh in Zeisu a lawn’ nading a zong uh hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, ama tung pan vangliatna paikhia a, mi khempeuh a damsak hi.
Zeisu in a nungzuite en a, “Mizawng note in thupha na ngah ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pasian’ Gam in note gam ahi ding hi.

Tu lai taka gilkial note in, thupha na ngah ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, gilvahna na ngah ding uh hi. Tu lai taka a kap note in thupha na ngah ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, na nui ding uh hi.
Mite in Mihing Tapa hangin note muhdah uh a, hong hawlkhiat uh a, hong kosiat uh a, na min uh hong siatsak ciangin, thupha na ngah ding uh hi.
Tua lai takin nuam un la, lungdamin na diang un. Bang hang hiam na cih leh, vantungah nop tuamna lian na ngah ding uh hi. A pute a pate un zong kamsangte tua bangin a bawlsia uh hi.
Sumhau note in gimna na thuak ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, nopna na ngah zo uh hi.

Tu lai takin an kham note in gimna na thuak ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, note na gilkial ding uh hi. Tu lai taka nui note in gimna na thuak ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, note in thuumin na kap ding uh hi.
Mi khempeuh in note hong phat ciangin, gimna na thuak ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, a pute a pate un thuzuau kamsangte tungah tua bangin a bawl uh hi.
Ka kam a za note kiangah kong cih-inah, na galte na it un. Hong mudahte tungah thupha na bawl un.
Hong phuisamte tungah thupha na pia un.
Hong bawlsiate ading thu na ngetsak un. Na pang langkhat hong bengte, pang langkhat zong na bengsak un. Na puanza a late, na puan ak lak ding na khaam kei un.
A hong ngen khempeuhte na pia un. Na sum a late kiangah, na sum na ngen kik kei un.
Note tungah hong kibawl ding na deih bangun, mite tungah zong na bawl un.
Hong itte bek na it uh leh, bang phattuamna na nei uh hiam? Migilote in zong amau a itte a it uh hi.
Note tungah thupha hong bawl mite tung bekah thupha na bawl uh leh, bang phattuamna na nei uh hiam? Migilote in zong tua bangin ahih uh hi.
Midangte sum na leitawisak uh ciangin, hong lohkik ding ci-in, lamenin na tawisak uh leh, bang phattuamna na nei uh hiam? Migilote in zong a piak bang a ngah kik nadingin migilote a leitawisak uh hi.

Note na hih uh leh, na galte na it un, amaute tungah thupha na bawl un. Na khatpeuh ka ngah ding hi ci-in lamen loin na leitawisak un. Tua bang na hih uh leh, na noptuamna uh lian ding a, Sang Bel Pasian’ tate na hi ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, amah in hehpihna a thukkik lo mi leh migilote a hehpih hi.
Na Pa un hehpihna lungsim a neih bangin note in zong hehpihna lungsim na nei un.”

“Midangte’ thu na tan kei uh leh, thu tanna tawh na kipelh ding uh hi. Midangte na mawhsak kei uh leh, mawhsakna tawh na kipelh ding uh hi. Midangte’ mawhna na maisak uh leh, note mawhna a kimaisak ding hi.

Midangte na piak uh leh, note hong kipia ding hi. Seeng a, teh hoih bek tham lo, a kinengcip, a kilok a kitat a dimlet a, om na ang sung uh ah hong kisung ding hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, midangte na piakna uh seengin, note zong hong kipia kik ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua lai takin Zeisu in thugentehna a hilh-inah, “Mittawte in mittawte lam a hilh zo ding hiam? A nih mahin leihawm sungah kia ding hilo ahi uh hiam?
A nungzuite in a siapa sangin lianzaw lo hi. Ahih hangin a kicingsa-a om a nungzui khempeuhte in a siapa mah bangin ahi ding uh hi.
Na mit sungah singluang lungngai loin, na u na nau’ mit sungah ninneng tang bang hangin na en hiam?

Na mit sungah singluang om napi-in na u na nau kiangah, ‘Unau aw, na mittang sungah a om ninneng tang hong paaikhiasak in,’ bang hangin ci na hi hiam? Nang mi simtatpa aw, na mit sungah a om singluang paaikhia masa in. Tua khit ciangin, na u na nau’ mit sunga ninneng tang paihkhiat ding na tel muh thei ding hi.”
“Gah hoih lo a gah singkung hoih a om kei hi. Gah hoih a gah kung hoih lo a om kei hi.
Kung khempeuh a gahin kithei hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, lingkungah mite in thei gah a lo ngei kei uh hi. Thangling kungah leenggah a lo ngei kei uh hi.

Miphate in ama lungsim sung sumkholna hoih sung pan a pha nate a pusuaksak hi. Mipha lote in a hoih lo sumkholna sung pan a pha lo nate a pusuaksak uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, tua pa’ lungsim a dim bangin a kam in a gen hi.”
“Keima thu ngai loin, ‘Topa aw, Topa aw,’ ci-in bang hangin hong ci na hi uh hiam?
Ka kiangah hong pai a, ka thu za a, a ngaite khempeuh in, kua mi tawh kibang ahih lam kong lak ding hi.
Amah in inn a lam ciangin, thukpi-in to a, suang tungah khuam a phut mi tawh kibang hi. Tui a khan’ ciangin hawktui in tua inn a nawt hangin, pha takin kilam ahih ciangin a liingsak zo kei hi.
Ka thu a zak ciangin a zui lo mi in, khuam phut lo lei tungah inn a lam mi tawh kibang hi. Hawktui in tua inn a nawk ciangin thakhatin a puk hi. Tua inn siatna in siatna lian ahi hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
